scripts.build: bun run manifest && bun run clean && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b --force
scripts.test: bun run build && node_modules/node/bin/node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.test:demo:quest: sh examples/quest/scripts/build-ui.sh && node_modules/node/bin/node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run examples/quest/test/quest.test.ts
scripts.test:demo:support: bun run manifest && sh examples/support/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b examples/support --force && node_modules/node/bin/node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run examples/support/test/support.test.ts
scripts.demo:hearth: sh examples/hearth/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b examples/hearth --force && node_modules/node/bin/node examples/hearth/dist/main.js
scripts.demo:quest: bun run manifest && sh examples/quest/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b examples/quest --force && node_modules/node/bin/node examples/quest/dist/main.js
scripts.demo:roam: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b packages/harngine examples/roam --force && node_modules/node/bin/node examples/roam/dist/main.js
scripts.demo:muse: bun run manifest && sh examples/muse/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b packages/harngine examples/muse --force && node_modules/node/bin/node examples/muse/dist/cli.js
scripts.demo:muse:live: bun run manifest && sh examples/muse/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b packages/harngine examples/muse --force && node_modules/node/bin/node examples/muse/dist/cli.js --live
scripts.demo:support: bun run manifest && sh examples/support/scripts/build-ui.sh && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b examples/support --force && node_modules/node/bin/node examples/support/dist/web.js
scripts.demo:support:cli: bun run manifest && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b examples/support --force && node_modules/node/bin/node examples/support/dist/main.js --cli
